title: Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description:
Manager, Stadium Entertainment

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days.

The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Stadium Entertainment Delivery

  • Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s).
  • Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament.
  • Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content.
  • Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners.

Team Support

  • Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Technical & Production Coordination

  • Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure.
  • Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues.
  • Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day.
  • Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s).

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
  • Assist in preproduction processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning.

title: Associate, Finance - Payroll
description:
The FSG Finance Associate supports the payroll department’s day-to-day functions, including end-to-end payroll processing, calculating fixed and variable payments, overtime, and off-cycle payments, and ensuring compliance with complex local labor laws (CLT) and tax regulations.

What You Will Do

  • Payroll data collection and validation, such as overtime, night-shift, new hires, terminations, and vacations.
  • Maintain and update employee records in the payroll system, including hiring documentation, salary changes, personal information, and bank details.
  • Reconcile payroll data with HR records and finance systems before bank transfers.
  • Monitor leave, sick pay, maternity/paternity leave, and vacation accruals, ensuring accurate deductions and salary adjustments.
  • Ensure accurate calculation of mandatory deductions, including social/security contributions, withholding income tax, and Severance Indemnity Fund (8% employer contribution).
  • Act as the first point of contact for employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, and tax documentation.
  • Assist with terminations, calculating severance payments, and handling new hire documentation.
  • Perform gross-to-net validations and partner with Finance to reconcile payroll funding and journal entries.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, providing payroll documentation.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement and efficiency in your area of responsibility while minimizing risk and cost.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Advanced degree.
  • One (1) or more years of experience.
  • Professional certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of data privacy and security principles.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and current tax regulations.
  • Proficiency with localized Brazilian payroll/HR systems (Cloudpay, Apdata) and MS Excel.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report payroll data.
  • Accurately and efficiently input payroll data into spreadsheets or payroll system; complete high-quality data reconciliations.
  • Technically proficient with payroll systems and strong knowledge of data analysis techniques and data visualization tools and software.
  • Experience with eSocial implementation.
  • Communicate basic insights from payroll data analysis.
  • Accountability / reliability / quality / service delivery.
  • Ability to demonstrate independent, objective, open-minded thinking with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Responsibility for actions, decisions, and results while holding self and team members accountable.
  • Meet expected levels of acceptable work quality (accuracy, completeness, & timeliness).
  • Communication: listens, clarifies, responds well, speaks clearly and persuasively, writes clearly and informatively.
  • Employee development: completes assigned and mandatory training; demonstrates understanding of tasks.
  • Leadership: all levels of the organization demonstrate leadership through actions and behaviors; act as a role model; embrace change; coach and develop key skills.
  • People / teamwork: actively participate in a team; collaborate effectively; respect individuals and recognize viewpoints; understand teamwork importance.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Payroll Supervisor.

description:
ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar todos os clientes, profissionais e usuários
  • Anunciar os visitantes aos setores solicitados
  • Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos, prestadores de serviços
  • Monitorar as imagens de locais específicos da Instituição (via circuito interno de imagens)
  • Efetuar atendimento telefônico com direcionamento aos processos conforme necessidade
  • Fazer a comunicação imediata de ocorrência de qualquer anormalidade com relação a pessoas, ou veículos nas proximidades da portaria
  • Zelar para o desenvolvimento das atividades com atenção e objetividade
  • Desempenhar as atribuições pertinentes ao cargo sempre com atenção e respeito a todos os profissionais e visitantes
  • Efetuar diariamente controle de acionamento e desligamento da iluminação das áreas comuns da Instituição, observando os horários e/ou necessidades
  • Auxiliar, quando solicitado e autorizado, os demais colegas da portaria em suas bases administrativas
  • Controlar para que pessoas que não pertençam ao processo ou que não sejam vinculadas a qualquer atividade dos setores da SPDM/PAIS, ingressem nas dependências sem autorização dos Gestores
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

Qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Local de trabalho: A.P. 3.3 (Madureira e bairros adjacentes)

Benefícios e Parcerias:

  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica por adesão
  • Assistência Odontológica por adesão
  • Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

title: Assistant Director of Career & Professional Development - Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. The Assistant Director will provide comprehensive career counseling, develop strategic partnerships with the judiciary, and oversee programs and initiatives that enhance students\'s and graduates\' competitiveness for clerkship positions. Additionally, this role will play an integral part in identifying and assisting with specialty fellowship development pipelines.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student workers, temporary personnel, administrative staff, and volunteers as needed. Reports to the Dean of Career & Professional Development, Lauren Jackson.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising: Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management: Develop and manage programs that increase students\' and graduates\' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.
  • Administer funding opportunities, including stipends and fellowships, to support students pursuing unpaid clerkships.
  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: Advocate for and support underrepresented students in pursuing clerkships and public interest careers, ensuring they have access to resources and opportunities.
  • Develop initiatives to increase diversity within judicial clerkships, including partnerships with affinity groups and diversity organizations.
  • Collaboration and Leadership: Work closely with faculty, administration, and other career services staff to integrate clerkship advising across the curriculum.
  • Represent the law school at regional and national conferences focused on judicial clerkships and relevant public interest areas.
  • Stay informed of trends and developments in judicial clerkships to provide the most current and relevant advice to students and alumni.
  • Develop a clerkship advisory committee to assist with clerkship application review and advising.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in career services or academic advising in a law school setting.
  • Proven track record of placing students or graduates in judicial clerkships.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations related to judicial clerkships or public interest law.

Minimum Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Experience in judicial clerkships, either through serving as a clerk or in a related advisory role.
  • Familiarity with fellowship recruiting and application process.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders, including students, alumni, and judges.
  • Familiarity with the judicial clerkship application process, including OSCAR.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range - $75,000 - $85,000

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy‑to‑use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Quantitative Objectives

  • New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)

Qualitative Objectives

  • Innovation in AI‑driven content repurposing

Who You Are

  • Technical ICP‑Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat

Technology Stack

  • HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Ser diverso é ser Super!

description:
Resumo do cargo


O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.



Responsabilidades



  1. Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls).

  2. Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação existentes.

  3. Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS.

  4. Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson.

  5. Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (software, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070).

  6. Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson).

  7. Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos).

  8. Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson.

  9. Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.



Quem você é


Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.



Requisitos



  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação.

  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore).

  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação.

  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office.

  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc.

  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais.

  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente.

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14.

  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.



Nossa cultura e compromisso com você


Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.


Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements.
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.

Skills & Competencies

  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Tidio is the customer service platform that aligns AI and people, so businesses can scale without losing trust or the human touch. Our goal is to help entrepreneurs grow by making customer service more efficient while keeping it helpful.

Working at Tidio means impacting thousands of companies and millions of their users. But our clients are not the only ones who can grow with us. By joining Tidio, you can grow, too!

Somos a Concremat, uma plataforma de integração do grupo CCCC, que conecta o Brasil e a América Latina a uma rede global de especialistas. Mais do que fornecer soluções técnicas de engenharia, somos protagonistas na construção e viabilização de grandes projetos, sempre em parceria com nossas empresas-irmãs. Nosso propósito é criar um futuro compartilhado, pautado no crescimento sustentável e na colaboração entre mercados, pessoas e tecnologias.

Atuamos em 15 países e mais de 200 localidades, ampliando constantemente nossa presença e impacto. Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

Estamos à procura de um(a) Técnico(a) de Enfermagem comprometido(a) em oferecer suporte de qualidade aos beneficiários, acompanhando de perto as demandas de saúde e promovendo um atendimento humanizado e eficiente.

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Sua missão:

  • Elaborar planos e executar manutenções.
  • Substituir peças, reparar e testar desempenho de componentes e sistema de veículos.
  • Efetuar diagnósticos e reparos em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos.
  • Realizar serviços de lubrificação dos veículos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Informática Básica.
  • Atuação em concessionária e formação em técnica em Mecânica Diesel, Mecatrônica e afins, será um diferencial.

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação-pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica-cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica-cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in software development who can design and evolve modern architectures, lead engineers through best practices, and collaborate directly with client stakeholders on solution design and technical decisions. You will set engineering standards for the team, perform code reviews, coach developers, and ensure we deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Define and evolve application architectures (monoliths, microservices, event‑driven), ensuring clear domain boundaries, integration patterns, and API contracts.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision‑making, balancing trade‑offs across scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Ensure non‑functional requirements (reliability, observability, security, and performance) are embedded throughout design and delivery.
  • Drive the development of high‑quality .NET services and APIs, setting technical direction for standards, versioning, and documentation.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD alignment, clean and secure coding standards.
  • Act as a technical leader, mentoring the team, fostering continuous learning, and enabling scalable, observable solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in software development and AI experience.
  • Solid architectural knowledge (DDD, CQRS, monolith vs. microservices, event‑driven systems).
  • Proven technical leadership, including code reviews, branching strategies, and guidance on best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core, API design, async programming, relational databases).
  • Experience with cloud environments, containers, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of observability and security fundamentals.
  • Experience collaborating with front‑end teams and applying modern testing practices.
  • Ability to discuss solutions with client architects, negotiate trade‑offs, and justify decisions.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The specific and existing team takes care of the sales of industrial steam turbines in Latin America in different industries up to a size of 250 MWe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met optimally and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards

  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Supportive work culture and a healthy work‑life balance
  • Flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Flexible benefits and savings programs
  • Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell vacation
  • Parental leave
  • Profit sharing
  • Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives
  • Diversity and inclusivity focus

title: Knowledge Management Technical Author
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical communication, knowledge structuring and collaboration are essential to enabling engineering excellence?

Would you enjoy transforming complex technical information into accessible, clear and high‑quality documentation that supports teams across a global organization?

Join our Knowledge Management Team!

At Baker Hughes, Knowledge Management (KM) is essential for accelerating learning, promoting collaboration, and ensuring that expertise is captured and shared across the organization. Our KM team drives digital collaboration tools, documentation excellence, and user‑centric solutions that support engineering, technology and business functions.

Partner with the best!

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will collaborate with engineers, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop high‑quality technical documentation and maintain digital KM platforms—primarily based on SharePoint. You will help shape a business‑wide system that enables collaboration, governance and efficiency across Flexible Pipe Systems (FPS) and other OFSE teams.

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will be responsible for:

Technical Writing & Content Development

  • Researching and gathering knowledge from engineers and technical specialists to understand complex products, processes and systems.
  • Producing clear, concise and technically accurate documentation including manuals, guides, communication materials, instructions and support resources.
  • Applying translation responsibilities (English Portuguese) across the department.
  • Reviewing, editing and simplifying existing documents to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity.
  • Creating diagrams, illustrations, screenshots and other visuals to support engineering explanations.

Knowledge Management & Content Governance

  • Updating and maintaining libraries of technical information within CMS platforms and KM repositories.
  • Ensuring documentation aligned with Baker Hughes standards remains up‑to‑date, correct and consistent.
  • Supporting implementation of KM methodologies, continuous improvement and Lean practices.
  • Identifying and eliminating roadblocks to knowledge sharing while promoting best practices.

SharePoint & Digital Collaboration

  • Creating, managing and updating SharePoint content, pages, templates and tools used across FPS.
  • Supporting system efficiency through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinating upgrades, improvements and fixes within the KM environment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Consulting

  • Meeting with teams to develop documentation, templates and SharePoint content aligned with business needs.
  • Reviewing new materials with users and experts to ensure relevance and quality.
  • Partnering closely with FPS Chief Engineers’ Office and global KM teams.
  • Advising on document formatting, intellectual property, branding, confidentiality classifications and export control requirements.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • Have fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Have proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Author or similar documentation‑focused role.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge Management principles and methodologies.
  • Have proficiency in MS Office and adaptability to digital tools used for documentation and collaboration.
  • Have experience with SharePoint (coding knowledge is beneficial but not required).
  • Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry or an equivalent technical sector.
  • Have excellent written communication skills with strong attention to detail and clarity.
  • Have the ability to learn complex technical topics and participate in technical discussions.
  • Have the ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Have familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE).
  • Have an understanding of the Engineering Lifecycle.
  • Willingness to travel internationally if required (desirable).
  • Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable).

Work in a way that works for you

In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from 7am-4pm or 8am-5pm.
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working for you

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sustainability Experienced Professional - Knowledge Management

A Bacio di Latte nasceu da paixão italiana por fazer gelato e do desejo de compartilhar essa delícia com o mundo. Aqui acreditamos que um bom gelato tem o poder de transformar qualquer momento em algo especial. É aquele sabor que abraça e aquele carinho em forma de colherada!

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Manutenção para executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos, de forma a assegurar o bom funcionamento de todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento das rotinas comerciais, administrativas e operacionais.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Executar cronograma do plano de manutenção das atividades destinadas;

  • Realizar manutenções corretiva e preditiva dos equipamentos da empresa;
  • Realizar anotações de solicitações no quadro de Gestão à Vista do escritório e sala de manutenção;
  • Ajudar nos registros e controle de balanças em geral;
  • Realizar preenchimento de permissão de trabalho para liberação de terceiros trabalhar internamente;
  • Atividades elétricas em geral da fábrica;
  • Atividades mecânicas e de refrigeração;
  • Realizar leitura termográfica nos quadros elétricos da fábrica;
  • Manutenção hidráulica da rede de esgoto, água potável e troca de filtros;
  • Auxiliar na manutenção da caixa de tratamento de influentes com limpeza e dosagem dos produtos em períodos de férias da equipe;
  • Realização de trabalhos em altura com reparos em telhados e caixas d’água.

O Que Buscamos

  • Necessário cursos na área de elétrica industrial, como: Comandos elétricos, conhecimentos mecânicos ou com equipamentos para sorvetes, cursos em refrigeração industrial; Integração, NR 10; NR 35.

  • Carteira de motorista em dia e sem restrições ou impeditivo para dirigir.
  • Experiência técnica com grandes e pequenos equipamentos de refrigeração - walk‑in e câmeras de grande porte de congelamento.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escalas alternadas como volantes.

O Perfil Que Combina Com a Gente

Benefits

Why Join Coderio?

At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a remote-first company, passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation.
